name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Dealership for Claude Code: the lot, the workshop and what needs attention, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Worst first. A delivered vehicle with no PPSR check outranks everything.
sections.sql: select reason, label, who, place, detail from v_attention order by rank, days desc nulls last limit 15

sections.title: Today in the workshop
sections.sql: select ref, promised_at as at, unit, customer, technician as tech, type, reason, state from v_ros where on_date = current_date and status in ('booked', 'open') order by promised_at nulls last

sections.title: Deals in play
sections.note: Deposits and quotes, with the compliance paper each unit still needs before it can deliver.
sections.sql: select ref, unit, customer, salesperson, opened_on, round(sale_price_cents / 100.0, 2) as price_nzd, case when cin_completed_on is null then 'CIN ' else '' end || case when ppsr_checked_on is null then 'PPSR ' else '' end || case when wof_issued_on is null or current_date - wof_issued_on > 30 then 'WoF' else '' end as paper_needed, state from v_deals where status in ('quote', 'deposit') order by opened_on

sections.title: Service due
sections.note: Every car we sold or serviced that has gone quiet. One call each.
sections.sql: select ref, unit, plate, owner, phone, last_seen_on, days_since, state from v_service_due order by days_since desc

name: money
title: The money
subtitle: Dealership for Claude Code: what is owed, unbilled, aged and low, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Owing
sections.sql: select ref, customer, unit, issued_on, due_on, round(total_cents / 100.0, 2) as total_nzd, state from v_invoices where status = 'issued' order by due_on

sections.title: Unbilled work
sections.note: Completed customer jobs with charges and no invoice. This is the write-off queue if nobody acts.
sections.sql: select ref, on_date, unit, customer, technician as tech, round(value_cents / 100.0, 2) as value_nzd from v_ros where state = 'unbilled' order by on_date

sections.title: Aged stock
sections.note: Days on the lot, recon sunk in, and the floorplan interest the unit has quietly cost.
sections.sql: select ref, unit, source, days_in_stock, round(cost_cents / 100.0, 2) as cost_nzd, round(recon_cents / 100.0, 2) as recon_nzd, round(asking_cents / 100.0, 2) as asking_nzd, round(floorplan_interest_cents / 100.0, 2) as interest_nzd from v_vehicles where kind = 'stock' and status = 'in_stock' and days_in_stock >= (select aged_days from v_settings) order by days_in_stock desc

sections.title: Front-end gross by salesperson, last 28 days
sections.sql: select s.name as salesperson, (select count(*) from deals d where d.staff_id = s.id and d.status = 'delivered' and d.delivered_on >= current_date - 28) as delivered, round((select coalesce(sum(v.gross_cents), 0) from v_deals v where v.staff_id = s.id and v.status = 'delivered' and v.delivered_on >= current_date - 28) / 100.0, 2) as gross_nzd from staff s where s.status = 'active' and s.role in ('sales', 'manager') order by gross_nzd desc

sections.title: Parts alerts
sections.sql: select code, name, stock_qty as on_hand, unit, reorder_at, state from v_parts where state <> 'ok' order by state
